description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kalawanegama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District (24/1111)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and property ownership matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, owner names, property details, and legal registration under the Registration of Title Act. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it focuses on land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
